title: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika

lines.say: Heetoh Heetoh no Mee, Model: Neeka. The Human-Human Fruit. The secret the world's rulers wanted buried.
lines.show: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika. The Human-Human Fruit. The secret the world's rulers wanted buried.

lines.say: For eight hundred years, the World Government tried to get its hands on this fruit. And for eight hundred years, it slipped away.
lines.show: For 800 years, the World Government tried to get its hands on this fruit. And for 800 years, it slipped away.

lines.say: The Five Elders even wondered if the fruit had a will of its own.
lines.show: The Five Elders even wondered if the fruit had a will of its own.

lines.say: So they hid the truth. In the records, they renamed it the Gohmoo Gohmoo no Mee. The Gum-Gum Fruit. Just a boring rubber power.
lines.show: So they hid the truth. In the records, they renamed it the Gomu Gomu no Mi. The Gum-Gum Fruit. Just a boring rubber power.

lines.say: When they finally caught it, secret agents guarded it on a government ship. Until Red-Haired Shanks and his crew attacked, and stole it.
lines.show: When they finally caught it, secret agents guarded it on a government ship. Until Red-Haired Shanks and his crew attacked, and stole it.

lines.say: The pirates kept it in a little chest. And a young boy named Luffy ate it as dessert, with no idea what it was.
lines.show: The pirates kept it in a little chest. And a young boy named Luffy ate it as dessert, with no idea what it was.

lines.say: For years, everyone thought it just made his body rubber. Stretchy, bouncy, and bulletproof.
lines.show: For years, everyone thought it just made his body rubber. Stretchy, bouncy, and bulletproof.

lines.say: But when the fruit awakened, his heartbeat began to pound. A rhythm called the Drums of Liberation. His hair and clothes turned white.
lines.show: But when the fruit awakened, his heartbeat began to pound. A rhythm called the Drums of Liberation. His hair and clothes turned white.

lines.say: It was the power of Neeka, the legendary Sun God. A warrior of liberation, said to free people from their chains.
lines.show: It was the power of Nika, the legendary Sun God. A warrior of liberation, said to free people from their chains.

lines.say: Now he can turn the ground itself into rubber, and fight like a living cartoon, limited only by his imagination.
lines.show: Now he can turn the ground itself into rubber, and fight like a living cartoon, limited only by his imagination.

lines.say: The fruit that ran for eight hundred years. Which devil fruit should I sketch next? Tell me in the comments!
lines.show: The fruit that ran for 800 years. Which devil fruit should I sketch next? Tell me in the comments!
